results_that_do_not_follow.reason: The coordinate run being 23 percent faster than the levels run is offered as a result, but the same paragraph says the machine was shared and the levels run took 126.5 s against 77.7 s in ADR 0509 for the same work, so the timing difference cannot be attributed to the ordering.
The roadmap entry states '98 s against 127 s per modal analysis' as a benefit of the coordinate order without the shared-machine caveat recorded at line 294 that makes the 127 s figure unreliable.

M6 is recorded as caught by P3(a) via the ordering's panic on a wrong length, not via the removed length check returning DimensionMismatch, so the decision at line 331 that every mutation was caught by a check named for it is stretched for this one.

limits_that_test_nothing.reason: E2's buckling-factor limit 1e-7 is 8 orders looser than the registered estimate of about 1e-14 and the recorded 1.9e-15 (and 100 times looser than E1's 1e-9 for the same kind of comparison), so a gross error in the coordinate factor would pass.
P1/P2 limit 1e-9 against recorded 6.3e-14 (and the same 1e-9 in E1 against 1e-15) leaves four to six orders of slack.
